text:
maya: Quick pass on Studio dark mode — overall layout looks solid, nice work! A couple accessibility nits I ran into: token heatmap legend text contrast feels low and the syntax highlighter blue is hard to read at small sizes.

oliver: Can you drop the exact color tokens you saw? I thought we moved to the 7-step purple->teal scale for heatmap.

maya: Legend text is using --color-muted-2 (#6B7280) on bg #0B0C0D. I measured ~3.2:1 for the smallest label (12px). WCAG AA for small text should be >=4.5:1.

sasha: Ouch. For charts we usually allow 3:1 for large text only. This is small UI copy. We should bump to --color-muted-1 (#9CA3AF) or switch bg to a slightly lighter surface.

frank: Agree with bumping text. Also noticed the token heatmap gradient has a mid-point that reads almost identical to the low bucket when rendered at 1px height — loses meaning. Maybe increase perceptual distance around the low->mid stops.

maya: Exactly. Example CSS snippet I used in dev tools to repro:
```css
:root {
  --heat-0: #2b0b3f; /* low */
  --heat-3: #6b3fa6; /* mid */
  --heat-6: #00b3a7; /* high */
}
.heat-legend {
  color: #6B7280; /* muted-2 */
  font-size: 12px;
}
```

oliver: Nice repro. I'm +1 to (A) increase legend contrast to --muted-1, (B) nudge the gradient stops so mid is ~10% lighter, (C) test on 1px and 2px heights.

sasha: Also callout: syntax highlighter uses `--code-blue: #2F80ED` which on our surface (#0B0C0D) measured ~4.1:1 at 13px. Works for large but not small. We should either slightly desaturate bg or darken the blue to hit 4.5:1.

frank: For code blocks we can also increase weight or use semi-bold for tokens to help legibility without pushing color extremes. Worth A/Bing.

maya: Proposal: update palette PR to: change legend to #9CA3AF, update mid heat stop to #7C4BB6, and darken code-blue to #265ECF. I can open a quick PR with screenshots and a11y contrast numbers.

oliver: Please do. @design-bot can you add a checklist? :slightly_smiling_face:

design-bot: Checklist created: [ ] legend contrast >=4.5:1 for small text; [ ] heatmap mid-step perceptual distance; [ ] code/token color >=4.5:1 for 12-14px; [ ] visual QA on 1px/2px heat rows; [ ] screenshot diff attached.

sasha: Thanks — if you can include a couple prod-ish dashboards (low, medium, high density) in the PR screenshots that'd be super helpful.

maya: Will do. Quick note: please don't change the token color names in the palette file — we should keep semantic tokens stable, only change underlying hex for easier rollbacks.

frank: Good call. Also adding a small keyboard focus nit: the focus ring on legend items is 2px and blends with the heatmap color when the item is active. Can we use outline color --focus-1 (#FFD369) so it stands out across palettes?

oliver: Agree. Make that part of the PR too.

maya: Cool — PR incoming in ~30m with screenshots + contrast numbers. Thanks all :heart:
